race.comment: MEDIA SPIN (2) wasn't disgraced last time over 1600m at Dubbo, beaten only 3 lengths into fifth at $5. Backmarker who keeps coming. Looks the runner in this line-up with the most upside and his best form puts him right in this contest. SNOW DOG (3) is backing up six days after finishing third over 1600m at Wellington. Strong run last time and is among the winning hopes. GREY BELIEF (12) finished a length back from the winner last start at Wellington on a soft track and is down in the weights this time. Rates strongly and expected to feature. SABATINA (5) has been in the market at her last couple of starts but hasn't made an impression, last start finishing sixth over 1600m at Queanbeyan. Maps nicely for this from gate four and can sneak into the finish.
